title: Semantic Contract Open Standard (SCOS) v1.0.0
description: Standard declarative schema for executable business metric contracts, semantic invariants, and runtime observability probes.

scos_version.description: The specification version of the SCOS standard.

id.description: Canonical URN identifier for cross-system contract registry resolution (e.g. urn:scos:finance:net_revenue).

metric.description: Unique identifier / slug for the metric.

version.description: SemVer version of the metric contract.

description.description: Human-readable description of the metric's business purpose.

owner.description: Team, domain, or email responsible for the business metric definition.

domain.description: Business domain (e.g. finance, operations, marketing, healthcare).

grain.description: Entity and temporal granularity of the metric calculation (e.g. customer_month, transaction_day).

dialect.description: SQL dialect used for compilation and AST parsing.

sql.description: The canonical ground-truth SQL query representing the metric calculation.

tags.description: Categorical tags for filtering and governance.

invariants.description: Formal structural and semantic invariant rules governing query AST validity.

required_filters.description: SQL predicate expressions that MUST be present in the WHERE clause.

forbidden_filters.description: SQL predicate expressions that MUST NOT be present in the WHERE clause.

timezone.description: Expected timezone for temporal aggregations and partition boundaries.

period_grain.description: Required time window partition (e.g. month, day, quarter).

required_aggregations.description: Aggregation functions that must enclose specified measure expressions.

required_subtractions.description: Components that must be subtracted from the gross sum (e.g. discounts, refunds).

probes.description: Runtime statistical reality probes verifying data distribution sanity.

metadata.description: Arbitrary organizational metadata, cost policies, and tool integrations.
